events.title: RIF: Re - Introduce Friction
events.note:
RIF IG PAGE RSVP link


RIF NITE #3 | Re-Introduce Friction (RIF) is a music-forward, no phones/surveillance-free dance party series amplifying the genres and club sounds of the Black and African Diaspora. We highlight how Black music and cultures are inherently interconnected, while deeply embracing queerness, connection and collective expression through dance and movement. The series is designed to bring real connection back to the dancefloor, as the music centers the Black and African Diaspora - moving across genres like Afrobeat, Alté, Club, House, Ghettotech, Hip-Hop, Dancehall, Ballroom, GQOM, Coupé-Décalé, Baile-Funk, and more afro-diasporic club sounds.
